title: Celebrity hairdresser and salon legend John Frieda dies aged 75
summary: John Frieda, the celebrity hairstylist and founder of the eponymous hair care line, passed away on 3 November, surrounded by his family

extraction.key_fact: 헤어케어 브랜드 존 프리다의 창업자 John Frieda가 세상을 떠났다.
